results.title: Antzarra Zerumugan
results.overview: The goose game ("antzar-jokoa") takes us to varied times and places, to countless stories throughout history. It has different identities in different places, just as the goose game of Lekeitio has its own, with its own personality. The documentary answers questions and creates new ones about the celebrations of this basque town and its people.

results.title: In illo αTempore
results.overview: Part seven of cycle "The Requiem Films". “I imagine that almost everyone who has come across this piece is familiar with the phrase ‘in illo tempore’. In illo tempore—in that time. […] Let’s pause for a moment on ‘tempore’. Let’s consider, as laypeople might, what part of the original phrase this is. Of course, it is technically ‘time.’ [..] When an extra letter ‘a’ appeared in my mind—which has a tendency to complicate all sorts of concepts to the limit—it completely changed the perspective of everything. ‘aTempore’ was born. What did that mean to me? If ‘tempore’ is, theoretically, ‘(at) that time,’ then ‘aTempore’ would mean ‘non-time.’ Now we have ‘That Non-Time.’ Does this mean we should think of time that has stopped? Or perhaps of different spaces, sensations? […]” - as the introductionary note to the movie says.

results.title: Flat Earth
results.overview: After years of obsessive research, a brilliant but isolated physicist succeeds in creating the world's first artificial black hole inside a secret laboratory. Instead of unlocking the secrets of gravity, the experiment tears open reality itself, revealing an impossible truth: the world is not a globe, but one of countless vast, layered planes stacked beyond human perception.
